comments:
In spite of the title suggested in an annotation on top of the first folio, this is not a topical outline of the Bodhicaryāvatāra (ID:3727). 
The text starts with announcing a discussion of the 5 "elements for explaining the treatise." The first (the author) covers 3 folios in (ID:5142), dealing with Śāntideva's (ID:3743) life, organized around seven specific deeds he performed and for each of which he received a different name.
The second element (the place of composition), the third (the title), the fourth (the purpose), and the fifth (the homage (?)), are all dealt with on the last folio side.
